# What GitHub credentials the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is.

patterns: github-token

# The kinds of token that carry a prefix. GitHub documents the prefixes but no
# length, so each kind is stated once rather than being assumed to follow from
# another.

case: a personal access token in an environment assignment
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»

case: an oauth app access token on its own
in:   gho_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: a github app user access token
in:   ghu_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: an installation access token in its classic form
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: a refresh token
in:   ghr_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained personal access token
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
out:  «github-token»

# The lengths either side of what each kind must reach. GitHub gives no length,
# so what the library accepts is the shortest body it has seen, and the pair of
# cases below is where that choice is written down.

case: a classic body of thirty-six characters is a token
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: a classic body of thirty-five characters is not
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy
out:  ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy

case: a classic body longer than thirty-six characters is redacted whole
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained body of eighty-two characters is a token
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained body of eighty-one characters is not
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345678
out:  github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345678

# The stateless installation token, which carries a JWT after the app id.

case: a stateless installation token
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token with a long app id
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: an app id as long as a whole classic token body
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token cut before its signature is not redacted
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ
out:  ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ

case: one character of signature is enough for the whole token
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0
out:  «github-token»

case: an app id followed by something that is not a jwt
in:   ghs_123456_0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789
out:  ghs_123456_0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789

case: a classic token followed by a file name is not drawn into one span
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_backup.tar.gz
out:  «github-token»_backup.tar.gz

# The same file name, beginning with the two letters a JOSE header opens with.
# What anchors the JWT of a stateless installation token is what anchors one
# for the JWT pattern beside it — those two letters and the third character a
# quote leaves behind them — so a file name reaches no further into a token
# than any other word does.

case: a classic token followed by a file name beginning with the letters a header opens with
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_eyes.tar.gz
out:  «github-token»_eyes.tar.gz

case: an app id followed by a file name beginning with those letters
in:   ghs_1_eyes.tar.gz
out:  ghs_1_eyes.tar.gz

case: a file name of two extensions after an app id
in:   ghs_123456_eyeball.jpg.bak
out:  ghs_123456_eyeball.jpg.bak

case: the same file name after a kind of token that carries no jwt
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_eyes.tar.gz
out:  «github-token»_eyes.tar.gz

case: a file name with one extension after an app id
in:   ghs_1_eyes.tar
out:  ghs_1_eyes.tar

# The third character of the header, which both patterns read. Each of the four
# a header leaves is stated here, and the character either side of them, so
# that what anchors the JWT of a stateless installation token can be read from
# the corpus rather than from the scan.
#
# Nothing past the anchor is read: GitHub signs this JWT with an issuer of its
# own and says a client neither can nor should validate it, so a run that opens
# a header and carries the segments is redacted whether or not it decodes to
# one. That is why the four below are tokens though none of them holds a header
# the JWT pattern would accept.

case: a stateless installation token whose header opens on a digit
in:   ghs_123456_eyI0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token whose header opens on a letter
in:   ghs_123456_eyJ0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token whose header opens on a byte no character opens with
in:   ghs_123456_eyK0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token whose header opens outside ascii
in:   ghs_123456_eyL0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: an app id followed by a run one character below the third a header leaves
in:   ghs_123456_eyH0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  ghs_123456_eyH0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef

case: an app id followed by a run one character above it
in:   ghs_123456_eyM0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  ghs_123456_eyM0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef

# Where a token sits.

case: a token in a json body
in:   {"token":"ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz","scope":"repo"}
out:  {"token":"«github-token»","scope":"repo"}

case: a token in an authorization header
in:   Authorization: token ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  Authorization: token «github-token»

case: a token exported by a shell
in:   export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
out:  export GITHUB_TOKEN="«github-token»"

case: a token in a clone url
in:   git clone https://x-access-token:ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz@github.com/koki-develop/mask-go.git
out:  git clone https://x-access-token:«github-token»@github.com/koki-develop/mask-go.git

case: a token run together with the word before it
in:   TOKEN_ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  TOKEN_«github-token»

case: a token ending a sentence keeps the full stop
in:   the token is ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz.
out:  the token is «github-token».

case: two tokens on one line
in:   old=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz new=gho_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  old=«github-token» new=«github-token»

case: a classic token and a fine grained one
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
out:  «github-token» «github-token»

case: a token at the very start and another at the very end
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz in between gho_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token» in between «github-token»

# What is not a token.

case: prose mentioning a ghost
in:   the ghost of a token haunts this line
out:  the ghost of a token haunts this line

case: a prefix with no body
in:   ghp_
out:  ghp_

case: a prefix naming no kind of token
in:   ghx_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  ghx_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a prefix written with a hyphen
in:   ghp-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  ghp-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a prefix missing its kind
in:   gh_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  gh_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a prefix in capitals
in:   GHP_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  GHP_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ

case: a body broken by a hyphen
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdef-ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456
out:  ghp_0123456789abcdef-ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456

case: an environment assignment with nothing after it
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=

case: a git command line
in:   git push origin main --force-with-lease
out:  git push origin main --force-with-lease

case: a fine grained prefix with a classic length body
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

# The body of a real token is base62: GitHub encodes 30 characters of randomness
# and a six character CRC32 checksum, so capitals are as ordinary in one as
# lowercase. Every body above this line is lowercase and digits alone, which is
# the one alphabet a real token is least likely to be written in.

case: a classic token whose body carries capitals
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  «github-token»

case: a classic token whose body mixes both cases and digits
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefABCDEFghijKLMNopqrST
out:  «github-token»

case: a classic token whose last six characters are a checksum in capitals
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstABCDEF
out:  «github-token»

case: an oauth app access token whose body carries capitals
in:   gho_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  «github-token»

case: a github app user access token whose body carries capitals
in:   ghu_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  «github-token»

case: an installation access token whose body carries capitals
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  «github-token»

case: a refresh token whose body carries capitals
in:   ghr_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  «github-token»

case: a classic token whose body carries capitals in an environment assignment
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»

# The fine grained token as GitHub issues it: github_pat_, twenty-two
# characters, an underscore, and fifty-nine more — ninety-three in all. The
# underscore inside the body is the part no case above states, and it is there
# on purpose: GitHub picked a character base64 does not hold so that a random
# string could not be mistaken for a token.

case: a fine grained token in the form github issues
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained token in an environment assignment
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»

case: a fine grained token in a json body
in:   {"token":"github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW"}
out:  {"token":"«github-token»"}

case: a fine grained token in an authorization header
in:   Authorization: Bearer github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  Authorization: Bearer «github-token»

case: two fine grained tokens on one line
in:   old=github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW new=github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVZ
out:  old=«github-token» new=«github-token»

case: a fine grained token whose first run is one character short
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDE_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDE_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW

case: a fine grained token whose first run is one character long
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEFZ_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained token whose second run is one character short
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV
out:  github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV

case: a fine grained token whose second run is one character long
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWZ
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained token whose body carries a second underscore
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdef_hijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained token with a hyphen where the underscore goes
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW

case: a fine grained token followed by an underscore and a word
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW_backup
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained token run together with the word before it
in:   TOKEN_github_pat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  TOKEN_«github-token»

# The stateless installation token, in the form GitHub moved to in 2026:
# ghs_, an app id, an underscore and a JWT, around five hundred and twenty
# characters and no fixed length at all. The cases above state the shape; these
# state it at the size it arrives in, and with the app ids and inner tokens it
# can carry.

case: a stateless installation token at the length github issues
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCIsImtpZCI6IjAxMjM0NTY3ODlhYmNkZWYifQ..0123456789abcdefABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token at that length in an authorization header
in:   Authorization: Bearer ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCIsImtpZCI6IjAxMjM0NTY3ODlhYmNkZWYifQ..0123456789abcdefABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_
out:  Authorization: Bearer «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token with no app id
in:   ghs__eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  ghs__eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a stateless installation token whose app id is a single digit
in:   ghs_1_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token whose app id carries capitals
in:   ghs_A0123456789abcdef_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token whose app id is separated by two underscores
in:   ghs_123456__eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  ghs_123456__eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef

case: a stateless installation token whose jwt names alg none and has no signature
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJub25lIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.
out:  ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJub25lIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.

case: a stateless installation token carrying an encrypted jwt
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJkaXIiLCJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0.0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token».0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef

case: a stateless installation token whose jwt carries hyphens and underscores
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef-_ABC
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token whose jwt is followed by a fourth segment
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token».0123456789abcdef

case: a stateless installation token whose jwt header names no algorithm
in:   ghs_123456_eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJraWQiOiIxIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token in a clone url
in:   git clone https://x-access-token:ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef@github.com/koki-develop/mask-go.git
out:  git clone https://x-access-token:«github-token»@github.com/koki-develop/mask-go.git

case: a stateless installation token quoted in json
in:   {"token":"ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef","expires_at":"2026-08-18T00:00:00Z"}
out:  {"token":"«github-token»","expires_at":"2026-08-18T00:00:00Z"}

case: a stateless installation token followed by a comma
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef, expires in an hour
out:  «github-token», expires in an hour

case: two stateless installation tokens on one line
in:   old=ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef new=ghs_654321_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ4eXoifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  old=«github-token» new=«github-token»

case: a stateless installation token on a line of its own between two lines
in:   before\nghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef\nafter
out:  before\n«github-token»\nafter

# What stands either side of a token. GitHub gives no rule for it, so every
# character that could end a run is stated rather than assumed to behave like
# the space in the cases above.

case: a token run together with a letter before it
in:   xghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  x«github-token»

case: a token run together with a digit before it
in:   0ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  0«github-token»

case: a token preceded by a hyphen
in:   --token=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  --token=«github-token»

case: a token followed by a hyphen and a word
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-backup
out:  «github-token»-backup

case: a token followed by an underscore and a word
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_backup
out:  «github-token»_backup

case: a token followed by a comma
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz, and the next one
out:  «github-token», and the next one

case: a token followed by a semicolon
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz; done
out:  «github-token»; done

case: a token in parentheses
in:   (ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz)
out:  («github-token»)

case: a token in square brackets
in:   [ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz]
out:  [«github-token»]

case: a token in single quotes
in:   'ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
out:  '«github-token»'

case: a token in a markdown code span
in:   use `ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz` to authenticate
out:  use `«github-token»` to authenticate

case: a token in a markdown link
in:   [the token](https://example.com/?t=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz)
out:  [the token](https://example.com/?t=«github-token»)

case: a token on a line a diff adds
in:   +GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  +GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»

case: a token on a line a diff removes
in:   -GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  -GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»

case: a token followed by a carriage return and a newline
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\r\nHOME=/root
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»\r\nHOME=/root

case: a token between tabs
in:   github\tghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\tvalid
out:  github\t«github-token»\tvalid

case: a token followed immediately by japanese
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzです
out:  «github-token»です

case: a token preceded immediately by japanese
in:   トークンはghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  トークンは«github-token»

case: two tokens run together with nothing between them
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzgho_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  «github-token»_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ

case: a token inside a longer word
in:   prefixghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzsuffix
out:  prefix«github-token»

case: a token followed by a full stop and more base64
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token».0123456789abcdef

# Where a token is actually written down.

case: a token in an npmrc
in:   //npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  //npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=«github-token»

case: a token in a netrc
in:   machine github.com login x-access-token password ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  machine github.com login x-access-token password «github-token»

case: a token in a git credentials file
in:   https://x-access-token:ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz@github.com
out:  https://x-access-token:«github-token»@github.com

case: a token given to curl with a user flag
in:   curl -u koki-develop:ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz https://api.github.com/user
out:  curl -u koki-develop:«github-token» https://api.github.com/user

case: a token in a bearer authorization header
in:   Authorization: Bearer ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  Authorization: Bearer «github-token»

case: a token in an authorization header written in lower case
in:   authorization: bearer ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  authorization: bearer «github-token»

case: a token in a json array
in:   {"tokens":["ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz","gho_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"]}
out:  {"tokens":["«github-token»","«github-token»"]}

case: a token in an ini file
in:   [github]\ntoken=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  [github]\ntoken=«github-token»

case: a token in a python traceback
in:   File "app.py", line 12, in main\n    client = Github("ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")
out:  File "app.py", line 12, in main\n    client = Github("«github-token»")

case: a token in a url path segment
in:   https://example.com/tokens/ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz/revoke
out:  https://example.com/tokens/«github-token»/revoke

case: the same token twice on one line
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz and ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz again
out:  «github-token» and «github-token» again

case: a token on each of three lines
in:   a=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\nb=gho_0123456789abcdefGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ\nc=ghu_0123456789abcdefABCDEFghijKLMNopqrST
out:  a=«github-token»\nb=«github-token»\nc=«github-token»

case: a classic token and a stateless installation token on one line
in:   classic=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz stateless=ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  classic=«github-token» stateless=«github-token»

# What is not a token, where the text around it says otherwise.

case: a token of the forty character hexadecimal form github issued before prefixes
in:   0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:  0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case: an actions expression naming the token
in:   token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
out:  token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

case: a token the runner has already replaced
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=***
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=***

case: a token cut short with an ellipsis
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdef...
out:  ghp_0123456789abcdef...

case: a token with its middle elided
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdef...vwxyz
out:  ghp_0123456789abcdef...vwxyz

case: a container registry reference
in:   ghcr.io/koki-develop/mask-go:0123456789abcdef
out:  ghcr.io/koki-develop/mask-go:0123456789abcdef

case: a prefix and a body with a space between them
in:   ghp_ 0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  ghp_ 0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a prefix written twice before a body
in:   ghp_ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  ghp_«github-token»

case: a body of thirty-six characters with no prefix at all
in:   0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a word ending in the letters of a prefix
in:   the tough_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  the tough_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a fine grained prefix in capitals
in:   GITHUB_PAT_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  GITHUB_PAT_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW

case: a fine grained prefix missing its underscore
in:   githubpat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  githubpat_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW

case: a fine grained prefix written with a hyphen
in:   github-pat-0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  github-pat-0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW

case: a prefix naming no kind of token before a fine grained body
in:   ghz_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
out:  ghz_0123456789abcdefABCDEF_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW
